### Meaning
| infl. | class    | meaning                  |
| ----- | -------- | ------------------------ |
| ~     | *n.*     | a skosh / lack, shortage |
| ~pi   | *quant.* | few, little              |
| ~an   | *adj.*   | few                      |
| ~un   | *adv.*   | hardly, barely           |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
oracle bone script of 少 (4 droplets), signifying a tiny amount
#### Sound
- *a priori:* b=weight, i=smallness
